card.name: Words leading into monitoring or treatment steps
card.fires_on: The word right before a treatment or monitoring instruction, such as "Prompt" before hemodialysis, "be" in "should be closely monitored" after stopping a drug, or "and" before activated charcoal in an overdose report.

modes.label: Prompt before hemodialysis
modes.description: The word "Prompt" opens the sentence recommending hemodialysis after lactic acidosis is suspected.

modes.label: Be before closely monitored
modes.description: The word "be" follows "should" when patients who stop a hepatitis B drug need monitoring.
modes.example: Patients who are co-infected with HIV-1 and HBV who discontinue DOVATO should<< be>> closely monitored with both clinical and laboratory follow

modes.label: List joiners in overdose management
modes.description: A comma or "and" inside a list of treatments given after an ingestion.
modes.example: following management with intubation, diazepam,<< and>> activated charcoal. A 45-year
